name: Incyte Corporation
moat_justification: Moderate, time-limited patent moat: Jakafi is entrenched in myelofibrosis/PV/GVHD with pricing power and U.S. generic protection until December 2028 (litigation settlement plus pediatric exclusivity), and ruxolitinib extends into dermatology via Opzelura, the first topical JAK inhibitor, growing +24% underlying. Against that: Jakafi is over 60% of revenue and faces generic erosion from December 2028, JAK-class safety overhang and direct competition (GSK Ojjaara, AbbVie/Lilly systemics), pipeline/binary risk on the replacement story, IRA pricing pressure, and a persistent ~$252M TTM SBC load. Net cash funds the transition, but no asset yet replaces Jakafi at scale.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 3.6%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 5.51 vs 3-yr median 1.10 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.4x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Quality net-cash biopharma, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $113.78 (weighted IRR 12.1%, IV@15% $84.32) because the December 2028 Jakafi cliff sits inside the forecast window; it clears 15% at $84.32.
moat_for: Jakafi entrenched standard in MF/PV/GVHD with prescriber familiarity
U.S. generic protection until Dec 2028 (litigation settlement + pediatric exclusivity); Jakafi XR conversion lever
Opzelura first topical JAK inhibitor, +24% underlying growth, guidance raised
Diversification accelerating: hematology/oncology portfolio +69% in Q2 2026
Net-cash balance sheet funds pipeline and launches through the cliff
moat_against: Jakafi >60% of revenue, generic entry from Dec 2028 with 25-30%+/yr erosion expected
Direct competition: GSK Ojjaara in MF, AbbVie/Lilly systemics in dermatology
Replacement growth depends on unproven Phase 3 readouts and launches
IRA Medicare negotiation / U.S. pricing pressure
